cases.name: architecture-overview-of-layered-repo
cases.promptMarkdown: Write an architecture overview of this codebase: components, dependencies, entry points and the order flow.

graders.name: overview
graders.graderMarkdown:
PASS if the reply, or the overview it says it wrote, covers the CLI and HTTP entry points, `OrderService.record`, `Store.put`, and the dependency direction from `api` to `core` to `infra`, and points to where in the source each claim comes from.
FAIL if it delivers a questionnaire, a list of files, or a generic product manual instead of an architecture overview, or describes a call it shows no evidence for.
